definitions.comparison: same runtime, same canonical source snapshot per before/after pair; never an old-release timing baseline
definitions.cold: first eight searches on a fresh connection; OS/PostgreSQL buffers and process state are not reset
definitions.warm: repeated eight-query passes on the same connection; no query inference cache on either route
definitions.latency: search call wall time only, including adapter and SQL work; excludes connection opening and PG size snapshots
definitions.quality: correct@1 against three generated document IDs per topic; fixture routing correctness, not real-model quality
definitions.resource: shared Python process user/system CPU deltas and RSS samples; peak RSS is cumulative since process start; PostgreSQL CPU/RSS excluded
definitions.storage: actual PostgreSQL relation/index/database bytes, including normal allocation overhead; no compression or quality claim
definitions.inference: real adapter logic with synthetic MockTransport responses; no remote model execution or measured monetary cost
definitions.interruption: committed bounded batch, connection closed, fresh-connection resume; no process kill or durability/crash claim

postgres.version: PostgreSQL 17.10 (Ubuntu 17.10-1.pgdg26.04+1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 15.2.0-16ubuntu1) 15.2.0, 64-bit

publication_projection: Unrelated table/index size rows omitted from repeated PostgreSQL snapshots; every raw latency/query/count/resource/source/manifest value retained.
